name: cafe-pos
description: A locally deployable cafe point-of-sale application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
